row.Finding: DuraPro ABS is not recommended for long-term or permanent outdoor use. Like standard ABS, it is prone to UV degradation, which can cause yellowing, brittleness, and reduced mechanical performance over time with prolonged sun exposure. For outdoor applications, consider DuraPro ASA, which is specifically formulated for improved UV resistance.
